Naturally and at a completely normal human pace, she transitions into standing upright in front of the bathtub, facing the camera with a warm open smile, the wall art prints prominently visible behind her. Lip movement and natural facial expressions throughout. All movement completely natural and human — no slow motion, no floaty movement. She stays visible in frame at all times. The camera performs a very slow smooth dolly-in throughout, keeping the wall art prints sharp and visible. Lighting: soft natural daylight, bright and even with a clean white ambient glow. Mood: calm, restorative, feminine bathroom sanctuary. Style: premium editorial home lifestyle.
